sn22.28:1.2: No cedam bhikkhave rūpassa assādo abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā rūpasmim sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.3: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi rūpassa assādo || tasmā sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjanti || || 4
sn22.28:1.4: No cedam bhikkhave rūpassa ādīnavo abhavissa || nayidaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.5: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi rūpassa ādīnavo || tasmā sattā rūpasmiṃ nibbindanti || || 5
sn22.28:1.6: No cedam bhikkhave rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa || nayidaṃ sattā rūpasmā nissareyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.7: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi rūpassa nissaraṇam || tasmā sattā rūpasmā nissaranti || || 6-8
sn22.28:1.10: No cedam bhikkhave saṅkhārānaṃ nissaraṇam abhavissa || nayidaṃ sattā saṅkhārehi nissareyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.11: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi saṅkhārānaṃ nissaraṇam || || tasmā sattā saṅkhārehi nissaranti || || 15
sn22.28:1.12: No cedam bhikkhave viññāṇassa assādo abhavissa || na yidam sattā viññāṇasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.13: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi viññāṇassa assādo || tasmā sattā viññāṇasmiṃ sārajjanti || || 16
sn22.28:1.14: No cedam bhikkhave viññāṇassa ādīnavo abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.15: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi viññāṇassa ādīnavo || tasmā sattā viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindanti || || 17
sn22.28:1.16: No cedam bhikkhave viññāṇassa nissaraṇam abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā viññāṇasmā nissareyyuṃ || ||
sn22.28:1.17: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi viññāṇassa nissaraṇam || tasmā sattā viññāṇasmā nissaranti || || 18
sn22.28:2.1: Yāva kīvañca bhikkhave imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam assādaṃ ca assādato ādīnavaṃ ca ādīnavato nissaranaṃ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññaṃsu ||
sn22.28:2.2: neva tāva bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇipajā sadevamanussā nissaṭā visaññuttā vippamuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā vihariṃsu || || 19
sn22.28:2.3: Yato ca kho bhikkhave sattā imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam assādaṃ ca assādato ādīnavaṃ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇaṃ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtam abbhaññaṃsu ||
sn22.28:2.4: atha bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇipajā sadevamanussā nissaṭā visaññuttā vippamuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā viharantīti || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || ||
